metadata.source: Public bug bounty methodology, our synthesis
metadata.provenance: Synthesized from public bug bounty writeups and methodology, no private data

phases.description: Define authorized targets, exclusions, allowed actions from program scope
Asset discovery: subdomains, endpoints, tech, auth surface (read-only)
Map inputs, sinks, trust boundaries, auth flows
Generate testable hypotheses from recon observations, map to CWE/OWASP
Test with witness payloads (minimal proof, not destructive), capture evidence
Capture tool output, response behavior, timing, errors as evidence
Map observations against known vuln classes (CWE, OWASP, CVE)
Verification specialist reproduces candidates, bypass exhaustion before false-positive
Evidence-based report, L3/L4 only for verified, L1/L2 as candidates, never rejected as confirmed
Store successful/failed workflows, false positives, verification strategies with provenance
Check remaining scope, uncovered areas, new hypotheses from learnings

methodology.evidence_first: Distinguish OBSERVATION (tool saw), HYPOTHESIS (might be vuln), TEST (planned action), EVIDENCE (tool output), VERIFIED FINDING (confirmed with repro steps). Never auto-convert observation to vulnerability.
methodology.scope_enforcement: Every mission must have explicit scope: target, authorized domains/IPs, excluded assets, allowed/prohibited actions, time/budget/concurrency. Boss enforces before delegating. Never silently expand.
methodology.verification: Candidate findings must go through verification specialist before reporting. Lifecycle: CANDIDATE → UNDER_VERIFICATION → VERIFIED or REJECTED. Bypass exhaustion before false-positive dismissal.
methodology.reporting: L3/L4 only for VERIFIED findings with high/confirmed confidence, L1/L2 as candidates pending verification, never rejected as confirmed. Every finding must have: ID, target, endpoint, vuln class, severity, confidence, repro steps, evidence, tool output ref, timestamps, agent, verification status, remediation.
methodology.rate_limiting: 200ms between active requests per host by default, don't bypass without operator approval
methodology.controls: Operator retains PAUSE/STOP/KILL ALL/RESET, high-impact actions require approval
